Introduction

Kep1er (stylized as Kepler) is a South Korean girl group managed by WAKEONE and KLAP Entertainment. Formed through the 2021 Mnet survival show Girls Planet 999, the group officially debuted on January 3, 2022, with their first mini album "First Impact". The debut was met with strong commercial success, with the title track "Wa Da Da" charting on the Billboard Global 200 and the album topping the Gaon Album Chart with over 400,000 units sold.

Building on their domestic success, Kep1er made their Japanese debut with the single "Fly-Up" on September 7, 2022, under Ariola Japan, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment Japan. The release debuted at number two on the Oricon Singles Chart and received a gold certification from the Recording Industry Association of Japan (RIAJ) after surpassing 100,000 sales.

In 2024, Kep1er became the first girl group from Mnet's survival project lineup to extend their contract beyond the original 2.5-year term. On May 30, 2024, WAKEONE confirmed that seven members — Yujin, Xiaoting, Chaehyun, Dayeon, Hikaru, Bahiyyih, and Youngeun — would continue activities as Kep1er. Members Mashiro and Yeseo concluded their promotions with the group on July 15, 2024, following a Japanese concert, and later joined the girl group MADEIN under 143 Entertainment.

The group transitioned to a permanent seven-member lineup and released their sixth mini album "TIPI-TAP" on November 1, 2024. The comeback marked their first official release under joint management by WAKEONE and KLAP Entertainment. Kep1er continues to build on their early momentum as a rising act in the global kpop industry.
